rationale: The plan correctly recognises raw integer STAR/featureCounts gene counts, explicitly rules out tximport and length offsets, and feeds the matrix to DESeq2 with ~condition, control as reference, an explicit treated-over-control contrast, median-of-ratios normalization inside the model, a justified count>=10-in->=3-samples filter, BH at 0.05 and apeglm shrinkage, with edgeR/TMM as a cross-check; the n=3 power caveat is stated repeatedly. QC covers library sizes, size factors, VST PCA, distance heatmap and a stated outlier policy, appropriate for a single-batch design. Deductions: the |log2FC|>1 subset is a post hoc filter rather than an lfcThreshold in the test; enrichment was not asked for and, though well specified (ranking metric, universe, size window), it omits collection versions; the report does not explicitly commit to recording package versions.
